manual.title: Jasco myTouchSmart
manual.description: The myTS Wi-Fi UDP and TLS relay paths are experimental. For Jasco Z-Wave products use Home Assistant's built-in Jasco integration. For myTS Wi-Fi products, keep the vendor app as the remote-control fallback.

data.cloud_relay: Emulate the myTS TLS control server
data.relay_advertise_ip: LAN address advertised to the app
data.name: Switch name

account.title: Find myTS devices
account.description:
Sign in to read your myTS device inventory. The app package and version are read automatically from the APK/APKS manifest; no app-version field is needed. Supply the app archive path on the Home Assistant filesystem. Passwords and signing keys are not saved.

Detected app version {app_version}. {details}

data.app_archive: Path to myTS app archive on Home Assistant

devices.title: Add discovered relay switches
devices.description: Select relay switches to add. Each uses GPIO pin 1. Other device types and additional pins need advanced setup. {unmatched} account devices could not be matched to a LAN address. Wake those devices and reconfigure this entry to scan again.

scan_result.title: LAN discovery results
scan_result.description:
{details}

Scan job {job_id}. Retry with explicit CIDRs for routed networks, or leave empty to use BlueberryProxy LAN interfaces. Account sign-in is reused.

error.incomplete_device: Enter all five device fields or leave all five empty
error.invalid_relay_address: Enter a private IPv4 address for the local relay
error.app_required: The app archive was not found on Home Assistant. Use its path on the HA filesystem, not the path on your phone or computer.
error.no_devices: No myTS devices are registered to this account.
error.no_lan_match: Account devices were found but no LAN addresses matched. Wake the devices and ensure HA and BlueberryProxy can access the same LAN.
error.archive_failed: Could not read compatible myTS app metadata or signing material. See the archive detail above.
error.proxy_failed: Could not validate the BlueberryProxy URL. See the proxy detail above.
error.login_failed: myTS sign-in failed. See the HTTP status or provider code above.
error.inventory_failed: myTS sign-in completed, but the account device list could not be read. See the provider detail above.
error.scan_failed: myTS account access worked, but the BlueberryProxy LAN scan failed.
error.cloud_tls_failed: The myTS cloud HTTPS certificate could not be verified. Certificate verification remains enabled.
error.unsupported_inventory: The account returned devices, but none contained the supported MAC and protocol identifiers.

abort.wrong_account: Sign in to the same account as this integration entry.
abort.already_configured: This account or device is already configured.

progress.network_scan: Scanning LAN protocols and myTS UDP responses. This can take several minutes.
